baseline.observedFailure: The resume displayed a publishing-process note about the approved resume artifact and phone placement. Shared case-study components also displayed instructions addressed to authors.
baseline.coverageGap: The existing rendered gate enforced standalone terms but not configured phrase rules. Generated HTML alone did not cover the dynamic work index.
baseline.originalRegressionResult: The newly added phrase regression tests failed before implementation; the old detector returned no finding for the resume note.

iterations.change: Remove the resume's internal note; shorten its introduction; remove the shared footer's publishing label and stop rendering publicSafety.note.
iterations.testFirst: Nine of the first eighteen public-language tests failed before the phrase implementation; all eighteen passed after it.

iterations.reviewFinding: Independent review found publishing backlog still rendered under Open, plus missing definition-list/accessibility-label normalization and dynamic-route coverage.
iterations.change: Preserve five backlog strings in editorialOpen, omit absent visitor Open blocks, extend phrase fixtures, and add a production-server route gate.
iterations.testFirst: Four of twenty-one phrase tests failed before normalization/backlog fixes. Thirteen initial live-gate tests failed before implementation. Final suites contain twenty-one phrase/source tests and nineteen live-gate tests.

preserved: Resume PDF and contact actions; no change to the approved PDF bytes.
Canonical claim wording, source relationships and asset permissions.
Collective credit, archived/unofficial service warnings, reconstruction labels, genuine uncertainty and care limits.
Editorial records remain available internally rather than being silently discarded.
futureProtection: Both static and live language checks run as part of every application build, including CI and staging builds.
Live coverage derives from build manifests; new page routes are discovered without extending a fixed allowlist. Parameter pages without generated examples fail visibly.
Known phrases are checked in reader text, metadata and accessible labels after inline-markup and entity normalization.
Positive controls retain legitimate approval workflows, artifacts, privacy statements, source custody and visitor-useful limits.
HTTP failures, redirects, non-HTML, empty inventories, timeouts and unavailable servers cannot pass as zero findings. The gate cleans up its own server.
limits: Finite phrase regressions do not detect every possible paraphrase or replace editorial judgment.
Automated and fictionalized-reader judgments are not human approval, real-person participation or endorsement.
This focused receipt is not hosted-CI, browser-review or deployment evidence. Those gates are checked separately against the release candidate.
